title.value: AmbieGen: A Search-based Framework for Autonomous Systems Testing
title.justification: The title clearly reflects the focus of the paper which is on a framework called AmbieGen for testing autonomous systems.
title.quote: Thorough testing of safety-critical autonomous systems, such as self-driving cars, autonomous robots, and drones, is essential for detecting potential failures before deployment. One crucial testing stage is model-in-the-loop testing, where the system model is evaluated...

extractions.description: The paper presents AmbieGen, an open-source framework that employs evolutionary search methods to generate test scenarios for autonomous systems like autonomous vehicles and robots. The framework aims to address the challenge of exhaustive scenario testing by identifying critical test cases that could reveal vulnerabilities or failures in these systems before their deployment.

primary_category.justification: The framework is indirectly related to climate change mitigation through its application in making autonomous systems safer and more reliable. Autonomous systems, such as electric vehicles, can contribute to climate change mitigation through more efficient transportation systems, reducing emissions by optimizing routes, and safer operation.
primary_category.quote: Autonomous systems, including autonomous vehicles, robots, or drones can provide a number of benefits such as driving assistance, high-risk zone exploration, and aid in rescue operations.

applications.value: Testing of autonomous vehicle systems for robustness and safety.
applications.justification: The application of AmbieGen is primarily around enhancing the reliability and safety of autonomous vehicle systems by generating critical test scenarios.
applications.quote: Currently, AmbieGen supports test case generation for lane keeping assist systems (LKAS) in autonomous vehicles and for autonomous robots navigating a closed room with obstacles.
